# Waybi

> Waybi is a maps and navigation product with worldwide destinations and a companion room. Provider coverage varies by location.

Canonical site: https://waybi.co/
Web app: https://waybi.co/app
Source repository: https://github.com/yaohuangguan/Waybi

## Product

Waybi combines route planning and turn-by-turn navigation with route-based and community road context. Official camera and speed-limit sources currently cover New Zealand. The mobile app supports Google Maps and an independent Waybi Map path with a Waybi-hosted NZ OpenStreetMap basemap and a global OpenFreeMap fallback. The web experience is backed by Cloudflare Workers.

Core navigation includes place search, route planning, route alternatives, voice and lane guidance where provider data is available, Journey Brief, parking discovery, trip history and route-aware fixed safety-camera reminders.

## Authoritative Waybi pages

- New Zealand navigation: https://waybi.co/new-zealand-navigation/

- Chinese overview: https://waybi.co/zh/

## Road data

Waybi uses published fixed safety-camera locations from NZ Transport Agency Waka Kotahi. The production backend checks the source every six hours and retains the last validated snapshot when a refresh cannot be trusted.

Camera data does not represent every mobile enforcement activity, direction of travel, enforcement lane or road hazard. Navigation and camera information are driving aids. Road signs, temporary controls, current conditions and New Zealand law take priority.

Route Watch checks saved Home → Work and Work → Home route corridors against official NZTA road events on a 15-minute schedule. It uses stored route geometry for background checks rather than continuously uploading a live GPS stream. Saved route geometry expires after 29 days.

## Availability

Core navigation is designed to remain available without Waybi Plus. Route Watch and manual camera sync are Plus features. Remote push delivery for Route Watch should not be described as complete until APNs / FCM delivery is wired end to end.

## Brand

Waybi's primary mascot is the Waybi kiwi bird. Clover is the cat companion and Sett is the corgi companion.

Tagline: A clearer journey.

## Waybi & Friends

The iPhone app includes a persistent animated companion room under Me → Waybi & Friends, accessible to guests. Waybi, Clover and Sett walk, rest and react in their room. Pack optional items for companion trips lasting a random 20 minutes to 12 hours. Returning trips add postcards and illustrated keepsakes. Confirmed real navigation arrivals can add journal memories and country-themed keepsakes; a specific landmark souvenir is not guaranteed.

Independent navigation follows heading and adjusts the camera by speed and upcoming turns. External waybi links and the Navigate with Waybi iPhone Shortcuts action open a destination for review. Google Calendar controls its own Open with picker; inclusion is not promised.

Official road events cover NZTA in New Zealand and Transport for NSW in New South Wales, Australia. A shared Worker snapshot refreshes every three minutes. Map road-event layers start enabled, Discover shows nearby events, and route previews flag matched closures. Route alternatives without a matched closure are preferred when available; guaranteed closure-aware detours are not implemented.
